issues.problem: Pilot savings (D8, week 20) rest on about 4 weeks of data after the week 17 readiness workshop; wave 2 plants get about 4 weeks before D11 (week 32).
issues.fix: Give the pilot a savings window after go-live and run 6 weeks of data after wave 2 before D11; lengthen P2 and note the new length for partner confirmation.

issues.problem: Wave 1 starts week 21, right after the pilot record D8 (week 20), but D8 is first judged at G6 in week 23, and G6 gates only wave 2.
issues.fix: Move G6 to week 21 as the go/no-go on starting wave 1 from pilot savings (D8), and set the wave plants there. Make G5's decision the pilot go-live.

issues.problem: Cost per part measurement is first aligned at G5 (week 17) and again at G7 (week 28), after baselines (week 4) and sizing exist; 'measurable amount' is never defined.
issues.fix: Have G1 agree how conversion cost per part is calculated across the six plants and what counts as a measurable cut; G5 and G7 then confirm it.
